annotation.bound_parties_text: The application for approval shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or his accredited representative; the Type Approval Authority and Technical Services verify conformity, and the holder of the approval must ensure conformity of production.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the steering equipment shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his duly accredited representative.
annotation.dates_quote: Incorporating all valid text up to: 03 series of amendments — Date of entry into force: 16 October 2018
